stewardship.deescalation: Not applicable to antibiotics. Continue supportive care and serial monitoring; escalate to inpatient/HDU monitoring if any warning sign for severe dengue develops.
framework: Dengue is viral - antibiotics provide no benefit and should not be given.
Avoid NSAIDs and aspirin given bleeding risk and potential for Reye's syndrome (aspirin) - use paracetamol for fever/pain.

Monitor closely from defervescence (typically day 3-7) for warning signs (abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, rapid rise in hematocrit with rapid platelet drop), as this is the critical period for plasma leakage and shock.

references: National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) India Guidelines
